open_assumptions: The raw 1.5.0 export inputs section (what seed.ts writes and the real server reads) uses the same field names and shapes as the served payload in PRD 4.7: decisions, challenge (+attempts, no run_id/version), completion untested/falsifying_check/verify_yourself, and per-worker questions. If the controller's export spells them differently, seed.ts must follow it.

Served run inputs are pinned at contract_version 1.4.0 for every run, older ones included (with null decisions/challenge/evidence and [] questions), the same way review results are pinned at 1.4.0. So every fixture projection now uses 1.4.0.
challenge.session_id and decided_at may turn out nullable in the controller's schema; the page handles both (the scratch stub types them as non-null).

A completion counts as legacy ('evidence was not recorded for this run') exactly when untested, falsifying_check and verify_yourself are all null. A completion with status 'question' shows 'no evidence yet' instead. The seeded waiting worker is served with that question completion.

falsifying_check links when it equals a declared check id, or exactly a declared check's command. The link goes to verify_<lane> with data-check-index for the matching executed check, the same way the existing task-check links work (there is no in-page scroll to the check).

Inert mode applies to every Markdown the viewer renders from run data: captured files, decisions.md and worker tasks (the Goal says 'every Markdown', which goes beyond PRD 4.8's list). Link targets and image sources are shown as plain text next to the link text or image placeholder.
The challenge node is identified by node_id 'challenge' together with kind 'review'. The independent review is the other review node.

In the candidate seed, the challenge node's status comes from an internal 'challenge' succeeded event. If the controller's server derives it from other evidence the snapshot status may differ; no test asserts that status.
The guarded run is synthetic: 'running', ui verified, the adapter's first verification blocked by the failure drill and its worker waiting on question 2.
result.summary: Implemented the viewer half of slice 2 (PRD_PORTABLE_WORKFLOW 4.5-4.8). Markdown.tsx: opt-in `inert` prop (default and non-project callers unchanged): links render as text plus target, images as labelled placeholders, nothing fetched. New src/projects/Challenge.tsx: challenge page (status, concerns grouped P0/P1/P2 with consequences, simpler alternative, cheap experiment, attempts, accepted reason); NodeDetail routes the `challenge` node (kind review) to it instead of the review panel, and the review-node lookup excludes it; status.ts isChallengeNode + executor 'one print job' (graph and node page). WorkerInputs.tsx: completion evidence (untested, falsifying check linked to the verify node's check by id or command with data-check-index, verify-yourself; 'not recorded for this run' when all three are null; 'no evidence yet' for status question) and a questions list with times, answers and a 'Waiting on the operator' marker. Assignment.tsx: decisions.md rendered inert, or a sentence when absent; captured files and tasks rendered inert. Fixtures/seed: inputs projected at contract 1.4.0 (null decisions/challenge/evidence, [] questions for older runs); new workflow guarded-flow with run-guarded (1.5.0 export): challenge accepted over P1+P2 at attempt 2, ui 1.1.0 completion with falsifying_check 'project-workflows-browser' and one answered question, adapter waiting on question 2 after a blocked verification, decisions.md and a captured src/projects/GUARDRAILS.md both with a remote image and external link. New tests/project-workflows/guardrails.spec.ts with the five scenarios. CHECKS ACTUALLY RUN. In this worktree (after `npm ci`, node_modules gitignored): `npm run build` exit 2, 19 TS errors, all missing contract fields (Property 'decisions'/'challenge'/'questions'/'untested'/'falsifying_check'/'verify_yourself' does not exist; 'question' not in the completion status enum). `WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=worker|candidate npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts tests/project-workflows/guardrails.spec.ts`: both exit 1 at config load: ZodError 'Invalid input: expected "1.3.0"' in validateRunInputs (contracts/projects/v1.ts:290) called from fixtures.ts projectInputs. Until the controller's contract lands, this blocks loading the whole project-workflows suite in this worktree. Pre-integration check in a scratch copy outside the worktree ($CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp/stub, identical src/ and tests/, confirmed with diff -r), with contracts/projects/v1.ts and server/projects.ts stubbed from PRD 4.7 by me, not taken from the controller: `npm run build` passed; guardrails.spec.ts 5/5 passed in the worker and candidate phases; the existing executor-marks, created-file-rendered, output-first-task-collapsed, findings-on-files, findings-by-reviewer, legacy-run and paths-redacted scenarios (filtered with -g) passed 7/7 in both phases; eslint on the changed paths was clean. With captured files switched back to non-inert, inert-markdown failed (2 <a> elements), so the test detects that regression. Not run: npm run test:unit or the whole browser suite, as instructed.
